CSES Problem Set

Permutations

  • Task
  • Statistics
  • Time limit: 1.00 s
  • Memory limit: 512 MB

A permutation of integers 1,2,\ldots,n is called beautiful if there are no adjacent elements whose difference is 1.

Output

Print a beautiful permutation. If there are several solutions, you may print any of them. If there are no solutions, print "NO SOLUTION".

Example 1

Input:

5

Output:

4 2 5 3 1

Example 2

Input:

3

Output:

NO SOLUTION
